description: Reviewed GTIN-to-canonical-variant evidence. This registry is read-only runtime input; entries require an exact valid GTIN, target variant, size and source URLs.

records.evidence_note: The live Parfum-Zentrum Product JSON-LD provides gtin13 3614272865235 for the exact 125 ml Eau de Parfum product; independent retailer/product-data listings corroborate the same identifier and format. The canonical target is the only declared 125 ml EDP variant among the two duplicate Profondo records. Keep the other product identity separate; this mapping assigns the variant only and does not merge product IDs.

The Sephora product catalogue PDF lists Acqua di Gio Profondo EDP 75 ml with GTIN 3614272865228; LadyParfum independently lists the same GTIN and 75 ml EDP. Assign only to the already-declared 75 ml variant under SH-0043. This does not merge SH-0043 with SH-AUTO-0019.

Live Parfum-Zentrum Product JSON-LD reports GTIN 3614273953849 for the exact 100 ml Acqua di Gio Profondo Eau de Parfum product. Its title says nachfüllbar (refillable bottle), not Nachfüllung/refill pack. Map to the existing 100 ml EDP bottle variant only; do not merge SH-AUTO-0019 with SH-0043.

Deloox Product JSON-LD explicitly reports GTIN 6298042001831 for French Avenue Liquid Brun Extrait de Parfum Limited Edition, size 150 ml, SKU 1385920. The target product SH-0031 and real variant VAR-f5aff76b4bb5de8a exist in backend/product_catalog.json at current main. The canonical product documents Extrait de Parfum; the standard Liquid Brun 100 ml is separate as SH-0030 / VAR-f87146c82d167f4c. This GTIN maps only to the existing 150 ml variant; OUT OF STOCK status and missing price are preserved by the retailer adapter.
